paper_title: Shining Light on the Dark Sector: Search for Axion-like Particles and Other New Physics in Photonic Final States with FASER
notes: FASER search for ALPs decaying to photon pairs using 57.7 fb^-1 of 13.6 TeV LHC data. The primary target is the ALP-W model (coupling g_aWW to W gauge bosons), with reinterpretations including ALP-photon (g_agamma), ALP-gluon, U(1)_B gauge boson, up-philic scalar, and Type-I 2HDM. The paper reports world-leading limits on g_aWW around 10^-4 GeV^-1 for masses up to 300 MeV. However, the primary coupling g_aWW (ALP to W bosons) does not map cleanly to AxionPhoton; the ALP-photon (g_agamma) interpretation is a secondary reinterpretation. No numerical exclusion data tables or extractable (mass, coupling) limit points are present in the provided text — the results section and exclusion contour values were not included. Confidence is low because the dominant coupling is g_aWW (not standard g_agamma) and no extractable data points are available. | Vision: Lower boundary of observed limit (90% CL) for ALP-W model from image 4.
